cohort: 200 pregnant females aged 20-30 years, 40 of whom delivered preterm and were divided into extremely preterm, very preterm, and control groups.
finding: Maternal serum proteins of 69kDa and 15kDa significantly decreased, while proteins of 23kDa significantly increased in women who experienced preterm birth compared to controls.
cross-section timing: Second and third trimesters of pregnancy
gest_age: N/A (outcome is defined by preterm gestational age at birth)
